Usage: gotools self-update [options]

  Aliases: self-upgrade

  Update gotools to the latest release from GitHub. Verifies the release SHA-256
  checksum before installing. The previous version is kept as a .old backup
  until the new one passes a 'version' self-check, and restored automatically if
  it does not.

  When a newer release is found, it asks before installing. Pass --yes to skip
  the question, as a script must: with no answer on stdin the update is
  cancelled.

  Examples:
    gotools self-update
    gotools self-update --yes

  Options:
    --yes  Install without asking for confirmation
